thread:
kevin: Postmortem follow-up: we saw partial responses + timeouts on the streaming/chat endpoint during the high-traffic window last night. Quick remediation plan: increase server ack_window to 150ms, introduce jittered exponential backoff in client SDKs, and add periodic keepalive pings. Owners and timelines below. TL;DR: avoid premature client reconnects that cause partial responses and overload.
maria: Can you paste the minimal config change you'll flip? I can own the rollout if it's small.
kevin: Here's the staging patch I tested (small YAML):
```yaml
streaming:
  ack_window_ms: 150  # from 50
  keepalive_interval_ms: 30000
  max_concurrent_streams: 1600
```
maria: sgtm. I'll canary in staging today at 14:00 PT. Plan: canary for 2h -> monitor partial-chunk rate, latency, and error budget.
olivia: We should add a regression eval to Redwood Optimize to detect this pattern automatically. I'll add a prompt set + an alert hook to catch reappearance.
samir: Noted. I'll update client SDKs (JS + mobile) with jittered exp backoff and doc the recommended reconnect window. ETA EOD tomorrow for PRs.
kevin: FWIW observed pattern: spikes correlate with bot-heavy traffic and when concurrent streams > ~1200. Proposing a circuit-breaker metric (stream_concurrency_overload) + alert if sustained > 10m.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: infra-rolling/staging/ack-window-1716400077 by maria at 14:00 PT
maria: :thumbsup: starting canary now, will post status updates.
maria: Canary stable after 45m, partial responses down ~78% and tail latencies slightly improved. Rolling to prod in 30m.

```
[2026-03-23T14:38:12Z] stream_id=abc123 ack_window=150ms ACCEPTED
[2026-03-23T14:39:01Z] stream_id=abc123 chunks=complete
```

samir: Client SDK PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234 (JS) and /pull/1235 (mobile). Tests included, added docs note for recommended reconnect jitter.
